entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I... I need to make a return. I just don't know what to do. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I'm even in your VIP club, but this is just so disappointing.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely help you with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
It's David Chen, order number VF78901. It's the new Aero Pro jersey. I saved up for it... and it just doesn't fit.

Okay, I see your order here, David. Thank you for being such a loyal VIP member with us. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault with the material or more of a preference on the fit?

It's the fit. I ordered my usual Large, but this jersey is just way too tight across the chest. I can barely zip it up. I had a big charity ride this weekend and I was so excited to wear it, but now... I guess I can't. It feels like the sizing is all wrong.

I completely understand the frustration, especially when you have an event coming up. It sounds like you need to do an exchange for a different size. Since you received the item just three days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was worried because I'd opened it. I just really needed this to work out, you know? Money's a bit tight and this was my one big purchase for the season.

Of course. It's no problem at all. We want you to be happy with your gear. I can process this as an exchange for the next size up right now. And because you're a VIP member and I know you wanted this for your ride, I'm going to upgrade the shipping on your new jersey to overnight, completely free of charge. You should have it in time for the weekend.
Wait, you can do that? For free? That would be amazing! You have no idea how much that helps. I was so down about this.

It's my pleasure, David. We appreciate your loyalty. I've just placed the order for the XL size with complimentary overnight shipping. I'm also sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. You can just pack up the jersey that's too tight and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you so much, Sarah.
You are very welcome. Enjoy your charity ride this weekend! Thank you for calling VeloFit.
